maddeler.e:
تقتضبوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَضِبُوا (taqtaḍibū) /taq.ta.dˤi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# تُقْتَضَبُوا (tuqtaḍabū) /tuq.ta.dˤa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
